pl-c09406ff152f.name: Outdoor dining patio · 2214 Mission
pl-c09406ff152f.summary: A proposal to turn a private parking lot into an outdoor dining patio. The record does not identify the operator. This is not evidence of a new restaurant opening.

pl-c91eb7cf4ca7.name: Bookstore & restaurant · former Hibernia Bank
pl-c91eb7cf4ca7.summary: A proposed bookstore, restaurant and events space in the former Social Security office at 22nd and Valencia, with outdoor dining. No trading name or opening date verified.

pl-15601b2479de.name: Rintaro · kitchen & seating expansion
pl-15601b2479de.summary: The existing Japanese restaurant proposes a rear second-floor addition for kitchen and storage space, plus 18 seats. Rintaro is already operating; the expansion completion date is not published.

pl-c3400fd2f1e2.name: Restaurant alterations · 921 Folsom
pl-c3400fd2f1e2.summary: The permit proposes full restaurant use and a storage mezzanine. The Roll now lists this address on its own website; the old permit has not been matched to a future opening.
pl-c3400fd2f1e2.recordLabel: Existing venue at address · permit unverified

pl-f5e832444581.name: Beach & Jones · proposed food-truck court
pl-f5e832444581.summary: Five food-truck stalls, pergolas, seating and bathrooms are proposed on a 5,000-square-foot site. Vendor names and an opening date are not verified.

pl-dbf4e6268bef.name: Wayfare Tavern · already open
pl-dbf4e6268bef.summary: Tyler Florence’s restaurant moved to 201 Pine Street in spring 2025 and is operating here. The city pipeline still includes the earlier exterior-work permit.

pl-a1c2d643c337.name: 101 California · tenant conference center
pl-a1c2d643c337.summary: A former frozen-yogurt space would become a 2,450-square-foot conference center for office tenants. This is an office amenity conversion.

pl-defb7bbf0e20.name: Union Street · bar & restaurant patio works
pl-defb7bbf0e20.summary: Proposed rear patio dining, exit stairs and changes to managers’ quarters at 1969–1979 Union. The permit does not establish a new restaurant name or opening date.

pl-cb00da25e7ee.name: Restaurant permit revision · 4072 18th
pl-cb00da25e7ee.summary: A revision addresses removal of a rear structure and changes to a residential floor plan. Poesia operates at this address, but this record does not establish a new Poesia opening.

pl-d5c317e31ff2.name: Casements · patio & entertainment proposal
pl-d5c317e31ff2.summary: The existing restaurant proposes nighttime entertainment and a 1,777-square-foot outdoor area on part of an adjacent parking lot. Completion has not been verified.

pl-ab89dd6d0d52.name: Pollo Campero · proposed expansion
pl-ab89dd6d0d52.summary: The existing restaurant at 2740 Mission proposes expanding into vacant 2744 Mission, adding 2,567 square feet. No completion date is published.

pl-f55dfc9b4a97.name: 680 Folsom · office lounge conversion
pl-f55dfc9b4a97.summary: A vacant former restaurant would become a 2,094-square-foot lounge and shared conference space for office employees.

pl-0f49fa17e833.name: Mendell Plaza · proposed restaurant structure
pl-0f49fa17e833.summary: A small restaurant structure is proposed on the triangular site at Third and Oakdale, facing Mendell Plaza. No future operator or opening date verified.

pl-a03108861bd4.name: Restaurant storefront works · 470 Pacific
pl-a03108861bd4.summary: The permit concerns replacement storefronts and restaurant entry doors in Jackson Square. It does not announce a new restaurant or confirm when this work will finish.

pl-f22af4b07614.name: Clay Theater · restoration & reopening
pl-f22af4b07614.summary: Restoration of the single-screen cinema, including seismic and accessibility improvements, with an accessory restaurant and entertainment use.

pl-8f07ec958c7c.name: Dante’s Inferno & Paradiso
pl-8f07ec958c7c.summary: A planned supper club and nightlife venue with a rooftop lounge at 1815 Market. The operator currently targets fall 2026; the older 2025 estimate is superseded.

pl-ccb652c1680d.name: Dante’s site · additional building proposal
pl-ccb652c1680d.summary: A separate 2026 application at 1815–1819 Market proposes a new lower level, expanded rooftop restaurant/bar and a Pearl Street takeout window. Related to the Dante’s site; this application’s own completion timing is unverified.
pl-ccb652c1680d.recordLabel: Related permit · not a separate opening

pl-a61d805265ea.name: Honey Cove Restaurant · proposed opening
pl-a61d805265ea.summary: The application names Honey Cove Restaurant and proposes combining two vacant storefronts at 2573–2575 Mission into one restaurant, with a mezzanine and storefront improvements. Cuisine, operator announcement and opening date are not verified.

pl-48599042fd4d.name: 160 Spear · office amenity conversion
pl-48599042fd4d.summary: The former Tokyo Express space would become office conference rooms, a lounge, bicycle storage and showers. This is not a restaurant opening.

pl-dd42d9d49d1a.name: Restaurant addition · 4483–4485 Mission
pl-dd42d9d49d1a.summary: A horizontal addition and new mezzanine are proposed for a limited-service restaurant. The available record does not name the business or give an opening date.

pl-2743654d99e7.name: 4100 Third · social-service facility
pl-2743654d99e7.summary: A proposal to convert restaurant and group-housing space into a social-service facility with an outdoor activity area.
